heroSummary: The CVESD year-round schedule opens July 22 with a minimum day. Across 180 school days, the district marks 51 minimum days, two parent-teacher conference periods, and extended Fall and Spring breaks that each span two school weeks.

calendarNotes: Chula Vista Elementary School District starts the 2026-2027 school year-round calendar on July 22, 2026 and ends on June 4, 2027. The official calendar lists 180 school days, 51 minimum days, 5 teacher prep days, Fall Break from September 21-October 2, Thanksgiving Week Break from November 23-27, Winter Break from December 21-January 11, and Spring Break from March 22-April 2. This page provides the official CVESD 2026-2027 calendar dates, plus parent planning guidance for breaks, minimum days, and school-year transitions.

calendarFaqs.q: When does CVESD start school in 2026?
calendarFaqs.a: The first day for CVESD students is Wednesday, July 22, 2026. The day is listed as a minimum day on the official calendar.

calendarFaqs.q: When is CVESD Fall Break in 2026?
calendarFaqs.a: Fall Break runs Monday, September 21 through Friday, October 2, 2026, with students returning on Tuesday, October 6, 2026.

calendarFaqs.q: When is CVESD Winter Break in 2026-2027?
calendarFaqs.a: Winter Break runs Monday, December 21, 2026 through Monday, January 11, 2027. Students return on Tuesday, January 12, 2027.

calendarFaqs.q: When is CVESD Spring Break in 2027?
calendarFaqs.a: Spring Break runs Monday, March 22 through Friday, April 2, 2027. Students return on Monday, April 5, 2027.

calendarFaqs.q: When is the last day of school for CVESD in 2027?
calendarFaqs.a: The last day of school for CVESD students is Friday, June 4, 2027.

calendarFaqs.q: When does summer break start for CVESD in 2027?
calendarFaqs.a: Summer break begins after the last student day on Friday, June 4, 2027. The final student day is also listed as a minimum day on the official calendar.

calendarFaqs.q: How many school days are in the CVESD 2026-2027 calendar?
calendarFaqs.a: The official CVESD 2026-2027 School Year-Round Calendar lists 180 school days.

calendarFaqs.q: How do I add the CVESD calendar to Google Calendar?
calendarFaqs.a: Download the CVESD ICS calendar file from this page, open Google Calendar, choose Import, upload the ICS file, and confirm the imported dates. The file is a one-time calendar import, not a live district sync.

calendarFaqs.q: Does CVESD have a year-round school calendar?
calendarFaqs.a: Yes. CVESD labels the official 2026-2027 PDF as a School Year-Round Calendar. The calendar starts in July, includes fall, winter, and spring breaks, and lists minimum days and teacher prep days throughout the year.

calendarFaqs.q: Why does CVESD start school in July?
calendarFaqs.a: CVESD uses a school year-round calendar structure instead of a simple late-August traditional calendar. Families should use the official PDF because the July start, fall break, winter break, spring break, and minimum days are planned as part of that district calendar pattern.

calendarFaqs.q: Are CVESD minimum days the same for every school?
calendarFaqs.a: The district calendar identifies minimum-day dates, but dismissal times and campus details may vary by school. Families should confirm minimum-day bell schedules with their child's school.

calendarFaqs.q: Does the CVESD ICS calendar update automatically?
calendarFaqs.a: No. The CVESD ICS file is a one-time import for a personal calendar. Families should check the official district calendar and school-site announcements for revisions or same-day changes.

customSections.label: Understanding the CVESD Year-Round Calendar
customSections.content: The CVESD school year-round calendar is different from a late-August traditional calendar because the student year begins in July and includes longer planned breaks during the school year. Families should read the calendar as a full-year planning system, not just a list of holidays.

groups.label: What year-round means on this page
items: The official CVESD PDF is labeled as a School Year-Round Calendar.
The student year starts on July 22, 2026 and ends on June 4, 2027.
The calendar includes Fall Break, Thanksgiving Week Break, Winter Break, Spring Break, minimum days, and teacher prep days.

groups.label: Why the July start matters
items: Summer planning ends earlier than it does for many August-start districts.
The first student day is also listed as a minimum day, so pickup and after-school coverage may need attention immediately.
Families comparing South Bay school calendars should confirm whether each district uses a year-round, traditional, elementary, or secondary calendar.

customSections.label: CVESD Minimum Days Explained
customSections.content: The official CVESD 2026-2027 calendar lists 51 minimum days. Minimum days are shorter student days, so they are especially important for pickup routines, childcare coverage, after-school programs, and conference-week planning.

rows: What is a CVESD minimum day?
A minimum day is a shorter student day listed on the district calendar.
How many minimum days are listed?
The official 2026-2027 calendar lists 51 minimum days.
The first day, school resume days, the last day, and the September and March parent/teacher conference windows are key planning periods.
Are dismissal times the same at every school?
Not necessarily. Families should confirm bell schedules and dismissal times with their child's school.

customSections.label: How We Verify CVESD Calendar Dates
customSections.content:
MySchoolDates reviews the official CVESD school calendars page and published School Year-Round Calendar PDF, compares key dates such as first day, last day, Fall Break, Thanksgiving Week Break, Winter Break, Spring Break, minimum days, parent/teacher conference windows, teacher prep days, legal holidays, and declared holidays, then converts the reviewed records into the calendar file used on this page.

The official CVESD calendar remains the source of record for revisions, school-site schedules, emergency closures, bell schedules, and same-day announcements.
